## Outcome

Requirement and scenario IDs; issue reference (use `Refs #1` for scaffold milestones).

## Change and Risk

Scope, compatibility, protected controls, dependency/token changes, and recovery.
Declare expected release impact or no-release rationale. The application is
licensed under Apache-2.0; scaffold delivery does not publish a package or release.

## Evidence

Exact source/integration candidate, commands, selected targets and rationale,
test/scenario identities, full affected-target coverage denominators, artifact
identity, actor/run, and retained results. Distinguish Passed, Failed,
Not applicable, and Not executed. Link red-stage evidence for behavior changes.

## Independent Acceptance

Identify test author, implementer, and verifier for consequential controls.
Record independent findings and their resolution, not only a green checkmark.
Token/pin changes need independent private-source regeneration and Product Owner
review. Engineering and Product/visual acceptance remain separate human decisions.
